svg.title: TIS 166 socket-outlet (female), mating face, earth hole up
svg.desc: Schematic front view with the earth hole up. Line hole lower left, neutral hole lower right, earth hole above the centre. Rings are female contacts. Proportions follow TIS 166 figure 3: 19 mm between the line and neutral holes, 11.89 mm from their line to the earth hole, 5.3 mm holes, and a 39 mm diameter face area centred 3.18 mm above the line and neutral holes.
